decisions.reason: The net price display plugin is close to the core shop offer and cheap to maintain, and with the industry growing and the firm hiring there is enough slack and no clear shortfall to justify dropping it, even though it is no longer visible on the website.
The ERP interface supports the firm's end-to-end and multichannel direction and strengthens client retention, so it likely meets aspirations and does not call for problemistic search.
The net price reporting plugin complements Product A for B2B shops at low cost, and absent evidence of a performance gap, available slack lets the firm keep carrying it.
